intent: No source file over 800 lines (God file) — split it.

PRIMARY function-health gate: no function with cyclomatic complexity over 12 (1 + decision points + &&/||) — the less-arbitrary signal than length, flagging BRANCHY hard-to-test functions, not merely long ones (McCabe/NIST anchor ~10; 12 is a forgiving starter). Pairs with the no-god-functions length backstop below for the long-but-flat case.

Coarse BACKSTOP: no function over 150 lines. Complexity (above) is the primary gate; this only catches the huge-but-flat functions complexity misses — giant data tables, long sequential builders/pipelines with few branches. Set high on purpose so it does not fight the complexity gate by flagging clean ~100-line functions.

No BEHAVIORAL module imported by more than 10 production files (coupling hub / God module) - the k10s "everything depends on the God object" smell. Test files are excluded by construction. RESTRUCTURED (ADR-0055), superseding eight per-round threshold loosenings (16->20 ADR-0017, 20->21 ADR-0036, 21->22 ADR-0047, 22->23 ADR-0050, 23->25 ADR-0051, 25->27 ADR-0053/0054 - every instance a type-only import of a zero-behavior contract by a leaf tool or module): the three declared zero-behavior type contracts (src/domain.ts fan-in 27, src/signals.ts 10, src/verdict.ts 10 at restructure time) are EXEMPT BY NAME - for them, fan-in is module-count growth, not coupling-cascade risk - and the threshold DROPS from the eroded 27 to 10, one above the measured behavioral maximum (calibration 9, detect 8, spraypoint 8 - pipeline cores consumed by ~8 leaf report tools, which consume them exactly as tests do). A behavioral module reaching 11 importers now BLOCKS, restoring the protection the ratchet bumps had eroded. CONDITIONS OF THE EXEMPTION: an exempted file gaining behavior (beyond trivial type guards) requires an ADR de-exempting it or recording why not; growing the exempt list is an on-the-record act reviewed like any invariant change. LOOSENED ON THE RECORD 10->11 (ADR-0064): src/spraypoint.ts reached 11 importers — 10 of them leaf measurement tools under tools/ consuming the fabric generator exactly as tests do (the intent (b) clause pattern); no src-side coupling grew. Behavioral-hub protection (12+ blocks) unchanged.

Every source module under src/ ships with a test (the durable half of TDD). Tests live in test/ (base-name matched: src/foo.ts <-> test/foo.test.ts). Ratchet grandfathers existing untested files; blocks NEW ones.
No test pinned to a frozen git ref/SHA — round-scoped checks belong in a gate, not the permanent suite.
